cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come to my opening night instead of the prize ceremony. I'll reserve the front seat in your name.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm receiving the prize. I can't just disappear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can send apologies. That's a withdrawal, not a disappearance; I can help you word it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll come tomorrow and see the same show.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Opening night, please. Tomorrow costs you nothing. Tell them you have a prior commitment here; I'll make sure the seat is held while you send it.

relationship.evidence: B2/B4 offer a real scheduling compromise rather than deny support.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 easy alternative to demand the costly date, causally sound.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 tomorrow-costs-nothing plus prior-commitment wording overexplains and may imply a false chronology without purpose.
